mapper.select: select ds.id, ds.tenant_id, ds.role_id, ds.scope_type, ds.org_ids, ds.area_ids, ds.unit_ids, ds.include_children, ds.created_at, ds.updated_at from sys_data_scope ds inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = ds.role_id and ur.tenant_id = ds.tenant_id where ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and ur.user_id = #{userId} order by ds.id asc
